The swing miss (1.37 V vs 1.5 V) comes from the PMOS. Its gate sits at vin, so V_SG is 1.05 V and V_DSAT is about 0.35 V. I'm adding a PMOS source-follower level shifter so the PMOS gate sits about 0.45 V higher. That moves the PMOS into moderate inversion and gives a small V_DSAT.

The follower takes its bias directly from the ibias port, so it adds no extra branch current. The main risk is the ibias source's compliance at about 1.25–1.35 V. If it is not an ideal source to vdd, this edit will fail.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Swing limited by PMOS strong inversion (Vsg=1.05). Add PMOS source-follower level shift biased by IREF to drive PMOS gate ~0.45V higher -> moderate inversion, small Vdsat, keeps PMOS gm in path."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":     (45e-6, 30e-6, 60e-6),   # main branch current
    "Ln":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),        # NMOS gain-device length
    "Lp":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),        # PMOS gain-device length
    "gmidp": (14.0, 9.0, 20.0),       # PMOS gain-device gm/Id (sets its gate level)
    "Lf":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),        # follower length
    "A_t":   (9.6, 8.5, 11.0),        # target |gain| (sets R)
}

def _solve_w(lut, dev, L, vgs, vds, I, vsb=0.0):
    W = 5.0
    for _ in range(8):
        o = lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds, vsb)
        W = min(max(W * I / max(o["Id"], 1e-12), 0.42), 4000.0)
    return W, lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds, vsb)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    I, Ln, Lp = p["I"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"]
    A_t = p["A_t"]
    vout0 = vin

    # NMOS gain device, gate at vin, carries I.
    Wn, on = _solve_w(lut, "n", Ln, vin, vout0, I)
    # PMOS gain device in moderate inversion, carries I.
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, I, vds=vdd - vout0)
    vg_p = vdd - mp.vgs
    # PMOS source follower (bulk = own source) shifts vin up to vg_p, biased by IREF.
    vsg_f = max(vg_p - vin, 0.2)
    vsd_f = vg_p
    Wf, of = _solve_w(lut, "p", p["Lf"], vsg_f, vsd_f, iref)
    af = of["gm"] / (of["gm"] + of["gds"])

    gm = on["gm"] + mp.gm * af
    G = on["gds"] + mp.gds

    dn = lut.size("n", max(on["gm_id"], 3), Ln, I, vds=vout0)
    cpar = dn.cdd + mp.cdd + dn.cgd + mp.cgd
    ctot = cl + cpar

    den = max(gm - A_t * G, 0.2 * gm)
    R = (A_t + 1.0) / den
    Rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / R + G)
    A = (gm - 1.0 / R) * Rout
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rout * ctot)
    # follower pole loading the PMOS path
    fpf = of["gm"] / (2 * PI * max(mp.cgg, 1e-15))
    gbw = A * f3db

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "ibias", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.M("MF", "vss", "vin", "ibias", "ibias", "pfet", Wf, p["Lf"])
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vin", R)

    power = vdd * (I + iref)
    swing = vdd - max(on.get("vdsat", 0.1), 0.05) - max(mp.vdsat, 0.05) - 0.03
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout0,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
